title: Smoky Barbecue Haloumi Burgers
subtitle: with Carrot Chips
description: Whether you’re full-time vego or part-time only, our varied range of vegetarian dishes really hits the spot. Bursting with veggies, dairy, legumes, grains and nuts, they’re packed with flavour, they’ll fill you up and they’re totally mouth-watering too!

steps.text: Roast carrot chips: Preheat the oven to 220C, fan-forced. Line 2 oven trays with baking paper. Cut the carrots into thin chips. Put the carrot on the lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to coat. Roast on the upper oven shelf for 15-20 mins until golden and tender.

Roast zucchini and tomato: Meanwhile, thickly slice the zucchini on an angle. Cut the tomato into thin wedges. Put the zucchini and tomato on the remaining lined tray, drizzle with 2 tsp olive oil and toss to coat (see Make it yours). Roast on the lower shelf for 10 mins or until tender. Remove from the oven and scatter with 1 tsp barbecue seasoning.
Warm rolls: While the vegetables are roasting, cut the rolls in half. Put on the tray with the carrot and bake for 3-5 mins until warmed through.

Cook haloumi: Slice the haloumi. Crush or finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a medium frypan over medium-high heat. Cook the haloumi for 1-2 mins each side until golden. Add the garlic and cook for a further 30 secs or until the garlic is lightly browned. Remove the pan from the heat.

Serve up: Combine the remaining barbecue seasoning and 2 tbs barbecue sauce in a bowl. Spread the roll bases and tops with the barbecue sauce, then layer with the haloumi, zucchini and tomato. Serve with the carrot chips and enjoy!
Make it yours: Feel like adding some potato chips too? Cut your peeled potato into thin chips, add them to the tray with the carrot in Step 1 and roast until golden and tender.
